tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall support playback of the predefined VR confirmation tones used by NAV and HFP functions. The software shall trigger the applicable start-of-listening, command-initiated, and VR-session-ending tone according to the corresponding VR interaction state

(Confirm the navigation voice session plays its start and end tones)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a Navigation voice recognition session
2. Record the tone played at the start of the session
3. End the session
4. Record the tone played at the end
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Navigation voice session starts
2. The configured start tone plays
3. The session ends
4. The configured end tone plays
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4865939 covers the tones NAV and HFP use to bracket a voice session. Both ends are read because a start tone alone leaves the user without the cue that the session closed.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall use the same predefined VR confirmation tone resources for NAV and HFP VR interactions to ensure consistent auditory feedback across both functions

(Confirm the hands-free voice session reuses the same tone resources)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a Navigation voice recognition session and record the start tone
2. Start a hands-free voice recognition session
3. Record the start tone and compare it against the one recorded
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Navigation voice session start tone plays
2. The hands-free voice session starts
3. The same start tone plays for both sessions
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4865940 requires NAV and HFP to draw on one set of files. The only way to observe sameness is to hear both and compare, so the case runs the two sessions rather than one.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall control confirmation-tone generation and playback according to the customer-configurable confirmation-tone setting. Confirmation tones shall be generated and played only when the setting is enabled and shall be suppressed when the setting is disabled

(Confirm confirmation tones are suppressed while the setting is off)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the confirmation tone setting to off
2. Press a touchscreen control
3. Record the audio produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The confirmation tone setting is off
2. The touchscreen press is accepted
3. No confirmation tone is produced
tcs.reasoning: 4865970 makes generation conditional on the customer setting. Written as a negative because the failure that matters is a tone sounding when the user turned it off.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall control confirmation-tone generation and playback according to the customer-configurable confirmation-tone setting. Confirmation tones shall be generated and played only when the setting is enabled and shall be suppressed when the setting is disabled

(Confirm the tones return when the setting is switched back on)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the confirmation tone setting to on
2. Press a touchscreen control
3. Record the audio produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The confirmation tone setting is on
2. The touchscreen press is accepted
3. The confirmation tone is produced
tcs.reasoning: The positive branch of the same condition at 4865970: a system that never generated tones would pass the negative case alone.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall classify Key Press Normal Tone (Conf1), Key Press Rejection Tone (Conf2), and Key Press Set Tone (Conf3) as confirmation-tone events and shall select the corresponding confirmation-tone configuration when the associated key-press event is received

(Confirm the three key press tones are distinguished by event)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press a control whose function is permitted
2. Record the tone produced
3. Press a control whose function is not permitted
4. Record the tone produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The permitted press is accepted
2. The acceptance tone plays
3. The rejected press is registered
4. The rejection tone plays and differs from the acceptance tone
tcs.reasoning: 4865971 names Conf1, Conf2 and Conf3. The classification only means something if the tones differ, so the case hears two of them against each other rather than checking one exists.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall generate each confirmation tone using the tone parameters associated with the requested confirmation-tone type, as defined in the applicable CFTS019-4865973 tone configuration

(Confirm the requested chime type drives the tone parameters used)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Request a confirmation tone of a given chime type
2. Record the tone parameters applied
tcs.expected_result:
1. The chime request is accepted
2. The tone parameters applied are those the table associates with the requested chime type
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866568 defers the parameters to the Chime Type table, a table object; the case verifies the mapping is applied, not the table's contents (IN 4.3.1 R-3).

tcs.test_item:
Upon a Conf3 tone request, the Audio Management software shall generate the confirmation tone as a sequence of Pulse A followed by Pulse B, ensuring Pulse A completes before Pulse B is initiated

(Confirm the set tone plays as pulse A then pulse B in order)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Request a Conf3 set tone
2. Record the sequence of pulses produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Conf3 request is accepted
2. Pulse A plays and pulse B follows it
tcs.reasoning: 4865974 gives Conf3 an internal structure the other two tones lack, so the ordering of the two pulses is what the case observes rather than the tone's presence.

tcs.test_item:
When the corresponding alert feature is enabled, the Audio Management software shall generate the requested Entertainment or Information alert tone using the tone definition and parameters mapped to the received alert event type in the applicable CFTS019-4865986 alert-tone configuration

(Confirm the parameters follow the received event type)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enable the entertainment and information alert feature
2. Raise an alert event
3. Record the tone parameters applied
tcs.expected_result:
1. The alert feature is enabled
2. The alert event is raised
3. The tone parameters applied are those the alert-tone configuration associates with that alert
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 021 and 023 share 4865986 under R-AM16 — package 20 section 1 re-anchored 021 there after route 2 found the ObjectID written in the leaf's own description, which the first route had not scanned for. This row observes the lookup keyed on the incoming alert event, so the brackets differ as that ruling requires. 4865986 is the waveform parameter table, a table object; the case verifies the mapping is applied, not the table's contents (IN 4.3.1 R-3). Out-of-pool anchor, single-source under R-AM18.

tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

This row observes the lookup keyed on the alert type already selected, one step further along the same path, so the brackets differ as that ruling requires. 4865986 is the waveform parameter table, a table object; the case verifies the mapping is applied, not the table's contents (IN 4.3.1 R-3). tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall map supported Information alert events to their configured alert types

(Confirm each alert event resolves to its own alert identifier)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Raise a sports alert event
2. Record the alert identifier used
3. Raise a traffic alert event
4. Record the alert identifier used
tcs.expected_result:
1. The sports alert event is raised
2. The identifier used is the one configured for the sports alert
3. The traffic alert event is raised
4. The identifier used is the one configured for the traffic alert and differs from the first
tcs.reasoning: 022 and 281 share 4865984 under R-AM16. This row observes the event-to-identifier mapping across the Information alert types. 023 takes the other half of the chain at 4865986: identifier to parameters, where these two are event to identifier.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall map each supported alert event to its corresponding system-generated alert definition and generate the alert using the configured parameters

(Confirm the reserved identifiers are held back from assignment)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Raise a sports alert event
2. Record the alert identifier used
3. Raise a traffic alert event
4. Record the alert identifier used
tcs.expected_result:
1. The sports alert event is raised
2. The identifier used is the one configured for the sports alert
3. The traffic alert event is raised
4. The identifier used is the one configured for the traffic alert and differs from the first
tcs.reasoning: 022 and 281 share 4865984 under R-AM16. This row observes the reservation of Alert6 to Alert8 for MIM, which the mapping alone does not establish. 023 takes the other half of the chain at 4865986: identifier to parameters, where these two are event to identifier.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall process requested Fade, Balance, and EQ parameter changes and transmit the corresponding parameter values to the HW audio interface using the provided audio parameter API

(Confirm a fade or balance change is transmitted to the amplifier)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the fade control
2. Read $ToneFADE$ and record it
3. Adjust the balance control
4. Read $ToneBAL$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fade adjustment is accepted
2. $ToneFADE$ reports the fade setting
3. The balance adjustment is accepted
4. $ToneBAL$ reports the balance setting
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: Partial coverage, ruled at package 20 section 2.4. 4866311 carries fade and balance only; the EQ and tone side of the leaf is at 4866090, which 043 and 048 hold, and the ruling assigns it to them rather than making a third leaf share it. This case therefore writes fade and balance and nothing about tone controls.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall evaluate $AudioSystemType$ and shall enable the software behavior allocated to Base/Fiat Booster audio-system configurations when the received system type is Base or Fiat Booster

(Confirm the base configuration behaviour is enabled for a base system type)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Configure the vehicle so that $AudioSystemType$ is "Base"
2. Start the head unit
3. Record which audio-system behaviour is enabled
tcs.expected_result:
1. $AudioSystemType$ reports "Base"
2. The head unit starts
3. The behaviour allocated to Base and Fiat Booster configurations is enabled
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4866042 scopes a block of requirements to the Base and Fiat Booster types. The leaf is the SWE.1 rendering of that scoping decision, so the case observes which behaviour set the type selects rather than any one requirement inside the block.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall initiate a confirmation-tone playback request upon receiving a valid touchscreen press event, excluding touchscreen locations designated as dead or non-interactive areas

(Confirm a touchscreen press raises a confirmation tone request)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press an active area of the touchscreen
2. Record the audio produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The touchscreen press is accepted
2. A confirmation tone is produced
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866057 ties the tone to touchscreen feedback and excludes dead areas, so the case presses an active area; the dead-area exclusion is a display concern the clause states but does not make observable in audio.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall support acceptance, rejection, and set confirmation-tone types and shall associate each tone type with its corresponding tone definition and parameters specified in the applicable confirmation-tone configuration

(Confirm each of the three tone types is available and distinct)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Trigger an acceptance tone and record it
2. Trigger a rejection tone and record it
3. Trigger a set tone
4. Compare the three recorded tones and record the outcome
tcs.expected_result:
1. The acceptance tone plays
2. The rejection tone plays and differs from the acceptance tone
3. The set tone plays
4. The three tones differ from one another
tcs.reasoning: 4866058 enumerates the three types. All three are exercised in one case because what the clause asserts is the set, and a missing third member is only visible against the other two.

tcs.test_item:
When the confirmation-tone feature is enabled, the Audio Management software shall enable confirmation-tone processing while the HU touchscreen is in an active state and shall process eligible touchscreen events for confirmation-tone generation

(Confirm tone processing is available whenever the touchscreen is active)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enable the confirmation tone feature
2. Bring the touchscreen to the active state
3. Press a control
4. Record the audio produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The confirmation tone feature is enabled
2. The touchscreen is active
3. The press is accepted
4. A confirmation tone is produced
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866059 conditions availability on the touchscreen being active, which is a different gate from the customer setting at 4865970 that leaf 016 covers.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall prevent generation of an additional acceptance or rejection confirmation tone for the current touchscreen interaction until the active touch location is released

(Confirm a second tone is not raised for the same press)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press a control once
2. Record the number of confirmation tones produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The press is accepted
2. Exactly one confirmation tone is produced
tcs.reasoning: 4866060 bars a repeat tone for the current press. Counting is the observation, since the defect is an extra tone rather than a missing one.

tcs.test_item:
Upon receiving a short-press event whose associated function is permitted for execution, the Audio Management software shall select and initiate playback of the configured key press acceptance tone

(Confirm the acceptance tone is chosen for a short press whose function is permitted)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Perform a short press whose function is permitted
2. Record the confirmation tone produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The press is registered
2. The acceptance tone plays
tcs.reasoning: 4866061 is one row of the three-way selection package 18 marks as a section 7 enumeration: the three ship together because each names a different press outcome, and testing one says nothing about the routing of the others.

tcs.test_item:
Upon receiving a short-press event whose associated function is not permitted for execution, the Audio Management software shall select and initiate playback of the configured key press rejection tone

(Confirm the rejection tone is chosen for a short press whose function is not permitted)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Perform a short press whose function is not permitted
2. Record the confirmation tone produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The press is registered
2. The rejection tone plays
tcs.reasoning: 4866062 is one row of the three-way selection package 18 marks as a section 7 enumeration: the three ship together because each names a different press outcome, and testing one says nothing about the routing of the others.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall select and initiate playback of the configured key press set tone when the received touchscreen event successfully performs a supported set operation, including setting a preset, tagging a song, or setting a favorite

(Confirm the set tone is chosen for a press whose function completes a setting)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Perform a press whose function completes a setting
2. Record the confirmation tone produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The press is registered
2. The set tone plays
tcs.reasoning: 4866063 is one row of the three-way selection package 18 marks as a section 7 enumeration: the three ship together because each names a different press outcome, and testing one says nothing about the routing of the others.

tcs.test_item:
When the Entertainment and Information Alert feature is enabled, the Audio Management software shall map each received enabled alert event to its configured alert type and shall generate the corresponding alert tone using the associated alert definition and parameters

(Confirm an enabled alert event produces its configured alert)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enable the entertainment and information alert feature
2. Raise an enabled alert event
3. Record the alert produced
tcs.expected_result:
1. The alert feature is enabled
2. The alert event is raised
3. The alert configured for that event type is produced
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: Re-anchored to 4865982 at package 20 section 1: the clause reads for each enabled event type, matching this leaf, where package 18 had it against 021. This row is the generation step; 021 and 023 at 4865986 are the parameters that generation uses.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall apply configurable tone-control parameters only to audio sources classified as Entertainment, and shall exclude Information and other non-Entertainment source categories from Entertainment tone-control processing

(Confirm tone controls act on Entertainment audio)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Adjust the bass control
3. Record the effect on the Entertainment audio
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The bass adjustment is accepted
3. The Entertainment audio reflects the bass adjustment
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866079 restricts tone controls to Entertainment. The positive half is here; 042 at 4866080 carries the other half, which is what the restriction actually protects.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall apply the neutral tone-control configuration to all audio sources classified as Information or Signal sources, independent of the user-defined Entertainment tone-control settings

(Confirm Information and Signal sources stay at the neutral tone setting)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the bass control while an Entertainment source plays
2. Trigger a Navigation guidance prompt
3. Record the tone setting applied to the Information audio
tcs.expected_result:
1. The bass adjustment is accepted
2. The Navigation guidance prompt starts
3. The Information audio carries the neutral tone setting
tcs.reasoning: 4866080 is the complement of 4866079: the user's tone settings must not follow onto information or signal audio. A system that applied them globally would pass 041 and fail here, which is why the case adjusts first and then triggers the Information source.

tcs.test_item:
Upon a user tone-control adjustment, the Audio Management software shall convert the requested Subwoofer, Bass, Mid, and Treble settings to their corresponding audio-control values and transmit them through $SUB_LVLSts$, $ToneBASS$, $ToneMID$, and $ToneTREB$ using the HW-provided interface

(Confirm a tone adjustment is converted and sent)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the bass control to a known level
2. Read $ToneBASS$ and record it
3. Adjust the treble control to a known level
4. Read $ToneTREB$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The bass adjustment is accepted
2. $ToneBASS$ reports the selected bass level
3. The treble adjustment is accepted
4. $ToneTREB$ reports the selected treble level
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 043 and 048 share 4866090 under R-AM16. This row observes the conversion — the user's level arriving as the signal value, so the brackets differ as that ruling requires. Package 20 section 2.4 keeps 025 out of this sharing: its EQ side is ceded to these two rather than making a third leaf cite the same object.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall transmit user-requested Bass, Mid, and Treble setup values toward the amplifier using $ToneBASS$, $ToneMID$, and $ToneTREB$, respectively. The transmitted values shall represent the currently requested tone-control configuration

(Confirm the amplifier receives the tone setup signals)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the bass control to a known level
2. Read $ToneBASS$ and record it
3. Adjust the treble control to a known level
4. Read $ToneTREB$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The bass adjustment is accepted
2. $ToneBASS$ reports the selected bass level
3. The treble adjustment is accepted
4. $ToneTREB$ reports the selected treble level
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 043 and 048 share 4866090 under R-AM16. This row observes the transmission reaching the amplifier, which the conversion alone does not establish, so the brackets differ as that ruling requires. Package 20 section 2.4 keeps 025 out of this sharing: its EQ side is ceded to these two rather than making a third leaf cite the same object.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall support 19 valid adjustment levels for $SUB_LVLSts$, $ToneBASS$, $ToneMID$, and $ToneTREB$

(Confirm the tone range spans nine steps either side of neutral)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the bass control to its lowest level and read $ToneBASS$
2. Adjust the bass control to its highest level and read $ToneBASS$
3. Read the distinct levels between them and record the count
tcs.expected_result:
1. $ToneBASS$ reports the lowest level
2. $ToneBASS$ reports the highest level
3. The distinct levels number 19, being nine below neutral, neutral, and nine above
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4866083 fixes the range at 19 levels. Both ends and the count are read because an off-by-one at either limit is exactly what a range requirement guards against.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall enable user adjustment of tone-control parameters through the HMI when TLM_Status.Info indicates Full-Operation or Timed state

(Confirm tone adjustment is offered in the full operation state)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set TLM_Status.Info to "Full-Operation"
2. Open the audio settings
3. Record whether the tone controls accept adjustment
tcs.expected_result:
1. TLM_Status.Info reports "Full-Operation"
2. The audio settings open
3. The tone controls accept adjustment
tcs.reasoning: 4866087 gates adjustment on the telematics state, the same shape as the volume gate B3 covered at 4866126. TLM_Status.Info is an internal signal name kept without a dollar wrapper per v3 (d).

tcs.test_item:
Upon receiving a user adjustment request for Bass, Mid, or Treble, the Audio Management software shall process the requested level and invoke the corresponding HW audio-control interface to apply the requested parameter to the audio processing path

(Confirm a bass, mid or treble request is processed to the audio path)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Adjust the mid control to a known level
3. Record the effect on the Entertainment audio
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The mid adjustment is accepted
3. The Entertainment audio reflects the mid adjustment
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866088 is the processing of the request where 4866090 at 043 and 048 is its transmission. The mid control is taken here because bass and treble are already exercised on the transmission side, so the three controls are covered between the leaves rather than repeated in each.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall map each user-selected Bass, Mid, and Treble adjustment level to the corresponding HW signal value

(Confirm each selected level maps to its defined signal value)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the bass control to the neutral level
2. Read $ToneBASS$ and record it
3. Adjust the bass control one step above neutral
4. Read $ToneBASS$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The neutral selection is accepted
2. $ToneBASS$ reports the value the mapping table gives for neutral
3. The one-step selection is accepted
4. $ToneBASS$ reports the value the mapping table gives for that level
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4866092 is the level-to-value encoding, a table object; the case verifies the mapping is applied, not the table's contents (IN 4.3.1 R-3). Two adjacent levels are read rather than one, since an encoding offset shows up as a shift and not as a single wrong value.

tcs.test_item:
For CAN-amplified audio systems, while cabin audio is active, the Audio Management software shall determine the alert playback level based on the active cabin audio level

(Confirm the alert level tracks the cabin level on a CAN amplified system)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Configure a CAN amplified audio system and play a cabin audio source at a known level
2. Raise an alert
3. Read the cabin audio level and the alert level and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN amplified system plays cabin audio at the set level
2. The alert plays
3. The alert level follows the cabin audio level as the specification defines
tcs.reasoning: 4866209 is the CAN-amplified counterpart of the default alert levels B4 covered at 306 and 307, so the system configuration is named in step 1 and the bracket says which system it is.

tcs.test_item:
When the Confirmation Tone feature is enabled, the Audio Management software shall route confirmation tones exclusively to the front speaker channels

(Confirm confirmation tones reach the front speakers only)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enable the confirmation tone feature
2. Press a control
3. Record the output channels carrying the tone
tcs.expected_result:
1. The confirmation tone feature is enabled
2. The press is accepted
3. The front speakers carry the tone and no other channel does
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4866283 says exclusively front, so the case reads the other channels too: exclusivity is only observable as an absence elsewhere.

tcs.test_item:
When the Entertainment and Information Alert feature is enabled, the Audio Management software shall route alert tones to the front speaker channels

(Confirm alert tones reach the front speakers when the feature is enabled)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enable the entertainment and information alert feature
2. Raise an alert
3. Record the output channels carrying the alert
tcs.expected_result:
1. The alert feature is enabled
2. The alert plays
